surfaces: new explicit CLI and source-free recovery

contract.authoritative_inputs: Approved #244 design; exact artifact arrival and all pinned prefix/catalog/raw resolution policy/registration data; scoped explicit command and attempt evidence
contract.authoritative_output: Typed resolved job journal and full current-attempt six-stage success plus separate first-retained source/prefix/resolved receipts
contract.scope_as_of: Exact tenant/project/site/version; pinned source/capture/context/catalog times; fixed-offset monotonic server lifecycle times and CAS/fences
contract.governing_policy: ADR045 explicit lifecycle/uncertainty and accepted ADR048; unchanged ADR046 normalized-exact matching/abstention
contract.evidence_retained: Full request/raw catalog/source bytes, six actual stage events, all source claims/resolution outcomes, current versus historical/first retention and command acknowledgements
contract.typed_failures: Resolved-job invalid/not-found, conflict/busy/fenced, integrity-invalid/unavailable with finite sanitized diagnostics; uncertain acknowledgement is never FAILED

scenarios.rationale: Empty and unresolved results retain source evidence; successful job execution is distinct from universal identity resolution.
Separate jobs can share computation while retaining current raw evidence; exact keys and real races prevent duplicate grant.
Exact scopes, catalog/source/context time, actual-offset and lifecycle counters fail closed; same instant does not erase offset evidence.
Zero/fraction/negative/unknown retain inherited normalization semantics; counters/cursors and lifecycle boundaries are explicit.
Malformed/oversize/deep/cross-profile/unsupported pins fail before capture/storage; codec is allowlisted.
Clean base/storage Python3.12/3.13 real shipped callers, every operation, source-free restart/recovery and uncertain acknowledgements.
Full legacy JSON/codec/rejection equality; stale head, active fence and transaction checkpoints prevent false success, not only happy-path persistence.
